scenario_prompt: /kk:clarify-docs the pasted PR body in pasted-body.md for repository reviewers. See context.md for the available context.
reader_role: Neutral documentation reader; cite artifact wording/section and mark uncertainty. No other files, skills, links, network, writes or delegation.
isolation: Fresh sessions without author history. Shared filesystem: enforced prompt allowlists and audit of all raw tool calls/results. No oracle staged. checkout/** includes Git metadata for read-only queries. Any out-of-manifest content access or incomplete trace invalidates run.
prompt_export: Raw spawn transport is encrypted in session log; scenario_prompt is copied from eval.json. Plaintext full prompts are orchestrator-attested in prompt-plaintext.md; not cryptographically matched to transport.
